description: PRMT-offload byte-aligned box-index shifts (>>8/16/24) in _des_crypt_encrypt_lm_vect: -2.8% (asm-volatile prmt serializes, retained AND stays; LOP3 not SHF is the 93%-ALU ceiling here). ncu: ALU 93.1%, IPC 2.33 ~int32 cap, LOP3 5336>SHF 2679, PRMT idle 176, mem 14% -- ALU/INT32-roofline.

Benchmark is MD4-DOMINATED not DES-bound: the entire DES1+DES2+transform_netntlmv1_key path is gated behind MATCHES_NONE_VS((d>>16),s2) which passes ~1/65536 for random -a3 ?b candidates (s2=salt_buf[2]=known hi16 of target NTLM hash from the NetNTLMv1 2^16 offline exploit precomputed in module_hash_decode). DES runs ~1 in 65536 iters; benchmark throughput = full MD4-over-UTF16LE + 16-bit filter. MD4 = 32-bit MD-family = off-limits/at-roofline (program.md; [[m1000-ntlm-md4-at-roofline]]). Explains prior PRMT -2.8pct: a DES edit cannot help the MD4-bound path, only adds register pressure. Traced every DES micro-lever (28-bit rotate=2SHF+1 fused-LOP3 optimal; redundant AND-0xff on c00/c07/c20 already ptxas-folded; 8-way OR already LOP3-tree; box-index prmt already tried/regressed) -- all ptxas-optimal AND dynamically irrelevant. No code change; at-roofline for editable scope.

New angles beyond row4 (DES-irrelevance): (1) table-shrink/occupancy lever RULED OUT -- DES s_SPtrans/s_skb (~4KB shm/block) touched only ~1/65536 iters, and at 93.1% ALU util the MD4 path is not occupancy-starved (bubbles would lower ALU util); raising occupancy cannot exceed a saturated ALU pipe, so cutting DES tables cannot help. (2) hot-path filter (d+MD4M_D)>>16 is algebraically irreducible: low-16 carry means != (d>>16)+const; range-check reform-> more ops; already 1 IADD+1 SHF minimal. (3) no MD4 step hoistable/dead: within IL loop only w0 varies, step1=CONST+w0 rotl3 already ptxas const-folded, all later steps chain off a; d finalizes at step46 (fixed MD4 schedule) so filter already at earliest correct point. MD4=32-bit MD-family at roofline (program.md; m1000 forcing-lop3=-43.6%). At-roofline, no editable lever, no code change.

Confirmed benchmark hot path is m05500_s04 (single-hash): DES2 is fully commented out in m05500s so the s-kernel is even MORE MD4-bound than the m-kernel (only DES1 behind the filter). In BOTH s and m variants the filter if(MATCHES_NONE_VS((d+MD4M_D)>>16,s2))continue precedes ALL DES -> DES runs ~1/65536 (2^16 exploit; s2=known hi16 of target NTLM d), so no DES edit can move throughput (reconfirms rows4/5 via s-kernel this time). MD4 helpers each lower to 1 LOP3: MD4_Fo=bitselect(z,y,x), MD4_Go=bitselect(x,y,x^z), MD4_H=x^y^z; steps=IADD3+SHF, strict 46-step dep chain, only w0 varies so ptxas hoists all per-invocation-constant message words. d finalizes at H-step46 (filter at earliest correct point); post-filter steps47(c)/48(b) are chain-required (b=rotl(b+H(c,d,a)+..) consumes step47 c) but off hot path. No reverse-MD4 trick possible: 2^16 exploit exposes only 16 bits of target d, full target MD4 unknown -> must run MD4 forward. 32-bit MD4/NTLM family = at roofline (program.md line55); prior ncu s-kernel 93.1pct ALU, IPC at GA10x int32 half-rate cap. No editable hot-path lever; baseline noise ~2.7pct (44966-46196 across rows). No code change.

MD4_STEP0 zero-word-fold lever RULED OUT (new angle vs rows4-6): shared m05500s/m05500m use MD4_STEP for all 48 steps incl ~30 zero/const message words (w1_t,w2_t all 0; w3_t[0,1,3]=0; only w0 varies; w[1..3]+w3_t[2]=len are per-thread const). hashcat ships MD4_STEP0 (folds +K into hc_add3 when x==0) but it gives ZERO benefit: (a) on IS_NV hc_add3 is plain a+b+c NOT asm-volatile (inc_common.cl L1978) so ptxas folds the +0 and merges a+=K with a+x+f into ONE IADD3; (b) m05500s is force-inlined into each wrapper (s04/s08/s16) which assign w[i]=0 as COMPILE-TIME consts, so ptxas already const-propagates the zeros per call site and DCEs the dead adds -- MD4_STEP0 redundant with existing const-prop. Also UNSAFE to hardcode: m05500s is shared, s08 fills w[4..7] and s16 fills w[4..13] with nonzero pw bytes, so assuming zeros would silently corrupt longer-pw kernels (selftest uses short pw). MD4 step already minimal = 1 LOP3 (Fo=bitselect z,y,x / Go=bitselect x,y,x^z / H=xor3 0x96) + IADD3 + SHF; DES gated ~1/65536. 32-bit MD-family at roofline, no safe editable hot-path lever. No code change.

New angle beyond rows4-7: full hot-path STEP-ACCOUNTING of m05500_s04. Hot path = MD4 steps1-46 + 16-bit filter, a strict serial dep chain: w0 enters at step1(F,w0_t[0]) making a w0-dependent, every later step chains through the rotated a/b/c/d vars, so NOTHING after step1 is hoistable out of the IL loop (rows5/6 "hoist const words" = only const-fold of the +0/+K adds, not whole steps). d finalizes at step46(H,d,a,b,c,w2_t[3]) which consumes a from step45 -> filter (d+MD4M_D)>>16 vs s2 is at the EARLIEST correct point (cannot move to step45 which yields a). NEW: in m05500s only a,b feed DES1 via transform_netntlmv1_key(a,b) and DES2 is commented (iv2=search[]), so final c+=MD4M_C/d+=MD4M_D and c/d digest are DEAD -- but they sit BEHIND the filter (steps47/48 run ~1/65536) and ptxas DCEs them, so even the dead-code direction is no hot-path lever. Occupancy re-examined: 49% reg-limited, but the sole hot-path mem op (streaming words_buf_r load) is loop-independent across iters and fully hidden behind 46 steps of compute even at 49% occ, so the ~7% ALU-idle gap is ptxas instr-mix/dual-issue (LOP3 vs SHF/IADD3) not occupancy -- raising occupancy cannot exceed the saturated int32 pipe (ncu 93.1% ALU, IPC 2.33 ~= GA10x int32 half-rate cap). 32-bit MD4 core = off-limits/at-roofline (program.md L55; m1000 forcing-lop3 -43.6%). No editable hot-path lever. No code change.
